However, there is a felt need to create a social security net for\nthe farmers as old age may result in loss of livelihood for many of them.  Farming\nrequires hard work in fields which becomes difficult at an advanced age. The problem is\ncompounded in respect of small and marginal farmers as they have minimal or no savings\nto provide for old age.
